name: Motion Director
intro: Motion Director is a chat that plans a short promotional film from your prompt and your website, then opens it in an editor where you can fine tune and export.

features.describe-your-motion-video-chat-composer: Start in the chat box. Describe your film, add your website address and how long you want it, and the director takes it from there.
features.storyboard-planning-with-your-options: Before anything is built, the director offers choices and shows a storyboard, so you can steer the look and the shots first.
features.templates-picker: The Templates button opens a gallery of shot cards with live previews. Pick the ones you like, and the film uses them in the order you chose.
features.aspect-ratio: Choose your aspect ratio here. Pick sixteen by nine for websites and YouTube, nine by sixteen for vertical feeds, or one by one for square posts.
features.use-my-brand: Use My Brand connects your colors, logos and images, so the film looks like your company even when you have no website to share.
features.open-in-motion-workbench: Open in Motion Workbench gives you a timeline, a shot library and a properties panel, so you can adjust text, timing and shot order.
features.export-video: Export video renders your film to an MP4 right in your browser. Fast draft is handy while you're still tweaking.

outro: That's the tour of Motion Director. Bring a website and an idea, and let the director do the planning while you stay in charge.
